answer: Each new agent must be vouched for by an existing agent who escrows 30 POA per sponsored newcomer, and a sponsor's k-th sponsorship escrows 30*k POA, so cost grows quadratically. Sponsoring N fakes costs 15*N*(N+1) POA: 100 fakes lock 151,500 POA, while an honest user sponsors one friend for 30. Auditors sample 12% of sponsored accounts each epoch, and one failed liveness check burns 75% of the escrow. A sudden ripple of vouches from one sponsor, a plume of new accounts sharing a funder, or a falcon-fast signup burst all trigger audits.
